name: Don't Starve Together
hint: Survival co-op server, joined from Browse Games through the game's relay

CLUSTER_TOKEN.title: Cluster token
CLUSTER_TOKEN.description: Required. Generate one at accounts.klei.com under Games, Don't Starve Together, Game Servers, signed in with the account you play on.

CLUSTER_NAME.title: Server name
CLUSTER_NAME.description: Players find the server by this name in Browse Games and join from there; the game falls back to NAT traversal and its relay because the server has no public IPv4. Restart the app after a game update so the server updates too.

CLUSTER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
CLUSTER_PASSWORD.description: Leave empty for an open server.

GAME_MODE.title: Game mode
GAME_MODE.description: Only used when the world is first created.
